verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a local Linux distribution, so data portability and avoiding lock-in are fair questions for it, but the evidence pack documents no first-party export-to-open-formats or migration capability. The `omarchy-snapshot create` feature is a system-snapshot and backup mechanism, which is an adjacent feature rather than data export. Community suggestions to reuse its dotfiles on another distro are user-side workarounds and earn no credit.
